{{Quote|Master Dam-Powl sent me to you and said you might be able to help. I hope so. Because I don't know how much more of this piss I can take.|Lanoree Brock, to Tre Sana|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
A potent '''wine''' was produced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]] from the [[deep-sea grape]]s and fortified with the [[swing dust]] [[air spice]] from some of the [[Unidentified Kalimahr air mines|air mines]] at the planet's north pole. In [[25,793 BBY]], the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] drank the [[Wine/Legends|wine]] with [[Tre Sana]] in [[Susco's Tavern]] on Kalimahr while investigating a group calling themselves the [[Stargazers]]. As it was incredibly strong, she used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to lessen the effects.<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The wine was first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
